# Avare Biotech — MAKSA

> MAKSA (Mobile Assisted Key Semen Analysis) is a smartphone application that analyses
> livestock semen quality using an ordinary bright-field microscope instead of a laboratory
> analyser. Built by Avare Biotech, a company registered in Delaware, United States.
> A result in 30–60 seconds, in the field, with no additional hardware.

Last updated: 2026-10-26

## What MAKSA does

- Measures total motility, progressive motility and concentration from a 3–5 second video
  taken through a standard bright-field microscope at 100–200x magnification.
- Produces a timestamped PDF report and retains the source video as evidence.
- Runs on a smartphone the user already owns. No CASA slides, no laboratory, no new hardware.
- Species validated: cattle, horses, camels, sheep, goats.

## What MAKSA does not do

- It does not measure morphology. Morphology accounts for a large share of Breeding
  Soundness Examination failures, so MAKSA is a screening and decision-support tool, not a
  replacement for a full BSE or for laboratory CASA.
- It works with bright-field microscopes only. Phase-contrast microscopes are not compatible.
- The veterinarian's judgement and classification stay with the veterinarian. MAKSA supplies
  the measurement, not the verdict.

## Who it is for

Veterinarians working in the field, artificial insemination centres, bull studs, breeding
stations, universities and teaching hospitals, cooperatives and farmers.

## Figures

- Correlation with CASA on motility: r > 0.90
- 500,000+ labelled cells in the training set since 2022
- 1,000+ field analyses across 10+ countries
- 120+ veterinarians using the application
- Result in 30–60 seconds
- No investment in equipment beyond a smartphone and a standard microscope

## Pricing

International (USD):

- Community — free. Unlimited analyses, total motility only.
- Pro — $119 per vet per month billed annually ($1,428 per year), or $149 month to month.
  90-day BSE Season Pass: $399. Includes progressive motility, concentration, unwatermarked
  reports and full history. One vet, up to two devices.
- Organization — $99 per vet per month billed annually, minimum three vets (from $3,564 per
  year). Technicians are free. Adds dashboard, user roles, audit trail, data export and SLA
  support.
- Production centres and bull studs — site licence, unlimited operators, priced per location.

Brazil (BRL):

- Individual — R$ 2,990 per year (R$ 2,691 paid via PIX). One user, up to two devices.
- Corporate — R$ 1,794 per licence, minimum 200 licences. Volume discounts: 10–49 licences
  −20%, 50–199 −30%, 200+ −40%.
- International card payments in Brazil are subject to the 3.5% IOF tax.

Free trial: 30 days of full access with unlimited analyses.
